🌟 Discover the ICICI mutual fund best plan 2025 that suits your investment style and risk appetite. From high-performing equity funds to stable and reliable debt funds, we've got you covered. 💰

🔍 In this video, we'll discuss the key features and benefits of each ICICI Mutual Fund, so you can make an informed decision. Whether you're a seasoned investor or just starting your investment journey, there's something here for everyone

🔍 ICICI Mutual Fund boasts 49 equity-oriented and 70 debt-oriented schemes, all meticulously designed to cater to diverse investors and financial goals. Among this impressive portfolio, three schemes truly stand out:

ICICI Prudential Bluechip Fund- Past 3 years return of 18.86% : With a remarkable 16-year track record, this fund is categorized as an equity large-cap fund, meaning it primarily invests in stocks of large-cap companies listed on the Indian stock exchanges.

ICICI Prudential Infrastructure fund- Past 3 years return of 39.28%: With 11 years of excellence, this fund specializes in infrastructure sector, providing a unique opportunity to invest in this growing sector with potential for significant growth.

ICICI Prudential Value Discovery Fund - Past 3 years return of 25.92%: The primary objective of the ICICI Prudential Value Discovery Fund is to provide long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in stocks that are considered undervalued relative to their intrinsic worth

Dive deeper into the world of ICICI Mutual Funds as Maneesh discusses these schemes, their strategies, and historical performance. Understand how ICICI Mutual Fund became a powerhouse in the industry, with more than 50 lakh investors.
